data.title: 在原七海 · 围巾织好了
data.description: 围巾终于织完，七海把它展开给你看，又认真检查了一遍针脚。你说很喜欢，她这才把围巾递过来，脸上露出一点笑意。
data.action: offering a knitted scarf to her partner
data.promptProse: Sitting on the comfortable living-room sofa, Nanami beams with a small, proud smile as she offers a newly knitted, soft wool scarf toward her partner. Sunlight streams through the sheer curtains, illuminating the intricate knit pattern and casting a gentle, serene glow on her face and the cozy, plush cushions of the sofa.
data.animaCaption: She holds the finished scarf out to her partner, who is outside the frame.
